## Parakeet ASR API

Parakeet ASR is a speech-to-text model by NVIDIA, available on the Venice API as `nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

### Parakeet ASR API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3` | Standard | Private | $0.36 / audio hr |

### Parakeet ASR specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | NVIDIA |
| Released | Oct 10, 2025 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |

### How to use the Parakeet ASR API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/transcriptions` with `"model": "nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/transcriptions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -F model=nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 \
  -F file=@meeting.mp3
```
